research_question: How does processed-reference discrimination relate to forward ranking?
answerable_finding: Strong processed-reference discrimination coexisted with a direction-specific forward ranking contrast
interpretation_ceiling: The reference is not temporal deployment or arbitrary-population evidence; one shared historical target

research_question: Do ranking changes transfer to frozen operating points?
answerable_finding: Ranking and frozen-threshold behavior separated; projected utility varied with prevalence and cost
interpretation_ceiling: No post-holdout adaptation; projections are analytic not field SOC observations

research_question: How sensitive are feature and explanation conclusions to representation split and learner?
answerable_finding: Feature effects were split/learner dependent; repeatability did not guarantee LIME fidelity; controls did not isolate one mechanism
interpretation_ceiling: No causal shortcut or universal explanation claim

research_question: Is transfer symmetric under explicit semantic bridges?
answerable_finding: Forward bridge retained signal while reverse was near baseline; bridge serialization had metric-specific effects
interpretation_ceiling: Only bridge62/bridge70 and direction-specific populations; cancelled cells are no-result

research_question: How do prevalence workload cost and computational constraints alter interpretation?
answerable_finding: PPV workload yield cost and component profiling can diverge or remain hardware-specific
interpretation_ceiling: Prior-shift and analyst assumptions are scenarios; timings exclude end-to-end pipeline and unsupported paths

research_question: What survives eligible-family evaluation and realization stability?
answerable_finding: Eligible family behavior was selective; several patterns stable
interpretation_ceiling: Bot learner-dependent;  Infiltration descriptive; temporal ordering was 5/5; Five seeds are descriptive; DOS/AUTH_BRUTE_FORCE ineligible; no zero-day or population guarantee
